name: io.walkeros/flow
title: walkerOS Flow
description: Build, validate, simulate, and deploy walkerOS event pipelines

environmentVariables.name: WALKEROS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: walkerOS API token. Optional, the local tools work without it and the auth tool can log in instead.

environmentVariables.name: WALKEROS_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default walkerOS project id (proj_...) used by the cloud tools.

environmentVariables.name: WALKEROS_APP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL override for the walkerOS app. Defaults to https://app.walkeros.io.
